tei:div.tei:p: This is the prayer for the welfare of President Franklin D. Roosevelt and the United States offered by the sixth rebbe of ḤaBaD, Yosef Yitsḥaq Schneersohn (“נתקנה ע״י כ״ק אדמו״ר שליט״א מליובאװיטש“), in advance of Rosh haShanah and Yom Kippur in 5701 (1941). While disseminated in both Hebrew and English, we only have the text of the prayer in Hebew, thanks to copies of the archival documant and a facsimile published at Chabadpedia and in a 2023 post at ChabadLive. Lacking the original English translation, we have made our own and set it side-by-side with the Hebrew.

Besides being disseminated to ḤaBaD affiliated synagogues, the prayer was also communicated to FDR with an accompanying letter (held in the collection of the FDR Presidential library). Here is the content of the letter in Hebrew (via ChabadLive) set side-by-side with its English translation as transcribed from the original document.
